note: Allocates size bytes of uninitialized heap memory that will later be passed to LZ4F_uncompressedUpdate.
uncompressedSize equals size, so the entire uninitialized buffer is used as uncompressed data.

code: lz4Return = LZ4F_uncompressedUpdate(ctx, dst + compressedSize, dstCapacity, uncompressedData, uncompressedSize, NULL);
note: Passes the uninitialized uncompressedData buffer to LZ4F_uncompressedUpdate.

code: return LZ4F_compressUpdateImpl(cctxPtr, dstBuffer, dstCapacity, srcBuffer, srcSize, compressOptionsPtr, LZ4B_UNCOMPRESSED);
note: Forwards the uninitialized source buffer to compressUpdateImpl with LZ4B_UNCOMPRESSED block compression.

code: dstPtr += LZ4F_makeBlock(dstPtr, srcPtr, (size_t)(srcEnd - srcPtr), compress, cctxPtr->lz4CtxPtr, cctxPtr->prefs.compressionLevel, cctxPtr->cdict, cctxPtr->prefs.frameInfo.blockChecksumFlag, blockCompression);
note: With autoFlush enabled, the remaining uninitialized source bytes are passed to LZ4F_makeBlock.
Even for uncompressed blocks, the HC compress callback is invoked on the uninitialized source data.

code: return LZ4_compress_HC_extStateHC_fastReset(ctx, src, dst, srcSize, dstCapacity, level);
note: HC compression is selected because compressionLevel >= LZ4HC_CLEVEL_MIN (3).

code: return LZ4HC_compress_generic(ctx, src, dst, &srcSize, dstCapacity, compressionLevel, limitedOutput);
note: Calls the generic HC compressor on the uninitialized source buffer.

code: return LZ4HC_compress_generic_internal(ctx, src, dst, srcSizePtr, dstCapacity, cLevel, limit, noDictCtx);
note: HC compressor reads uninitialized bytes from src while building hash chains, causing MSAN use-of-uninitialized-value.
